scope: Effective CP4-compatible 45-frame rank-16 attention LoRA smoke training
summary: The corrected training route completed two real optimizer steps on 172 native multiview videos and saved two verified adapter-only checkpoints.
evidence: The framework-saved effective config records num_frames=45, state_t=12, context parallel size 4, rank 16, and Q/K/V/output targets.
Iteration losses were finite at 0.2559 and 0.1337; both optimizer steps completed.

iter_000000001.pt and iter_000000002.pt are each 85,130,894 bytes with SHA-256 03ce1ab08c1fa924a2476dfca4f302d7bf1cdccd476c225757074534cb45a041 and 427f84d9cce771d208a97b0b0cd574651efaacfb6211ec524dc9bfc143180386.
The final checkpoint contains exactly 576 tensors and 42,467,328 values; every key is a net-prefixed lora_A or lora_B adapter tensor, so the immutable 14B base was not duplicated.
All prior external runtime overlays were moved into immutable run directories with hashes, leaving exactly one active registered overlay.
lessons: A 45-frame/state_t=12 curriculum is the longest tested short window that both preserves useful temporal context and exactly satisfies CP4.
Effective framework configs and adapter-key audits must be acceptance evidence, not merely launcher configuration.
limitations: Two steps prove the engineering path only; they do not establish video-quality improvement.
The adapter must still be loaded in the 93-frame inference pipeline and then trained to validation-selected checkpoints.
next_actions: Run a 93-frame development inference with the step-2 adapter to verify loading, then launch formal training with periodic adapter-only checkpoints and validation-only selection.
